title: RAW UNREVIEWED: named slot changes across parallel historical redactions
summary: A public pair of independently catalogued versions of the same illustrated technical entry might preserve a named object while replacing exactly one material, operation, or destination. Transcribe both full entries and their owner-bearing headings before target inspection. A candidate whole-form reading would need the same retained and changed roles across multiple admitted Voynich records; a shared picture alone has no word force. No suitable source pair or target binding is yet established.

design.mechanism: source-owned parallel redactions bind invariant versus substituted entry roles
design.unit: complete paired historical entries and complete admitted target records
design.contrast: role-preserving substitution versus generic common-topic or layout match
design.prediction: a frozen target reading preserves the independently keyed invariant term and localizes the changed term without repairs across every nominated pair
